A '''giant bat''' is an animal found in [[Daemonheim]], on [[abandoned floors|abandoned]], [[furnished floors|furnished]], and [[occult floors]]. It looks like a [[bat (Dungeoneering)|bat]], but is, as expected, bigger. It doesn't hit particularly hard for its level, but it is very accurate. Its specific [[magic|elemental]] weakness varies between individual giant bats.
